shipping-info.old_english: • Processing (1–3 business days): your items are checked and packed. Busy seasons can add 1–2 business days.
shipping-info.new_english: • Processing (up to 5 business days): your items are checked, packed and handed to the carrier. Most orders ship in about 3 business days.

shipping-info.old_english: • Arrived damaged? Take photos of the parcel and the item and email us within 7 days of delivery. See our Returns & exchanges page.
shipping-info.new_english: • Arrived damaged? Take photos of the parcel and the item and tell us as soon as possible, ideally within 7 days of delivery. See our Returns & exchanges page.

shipping-info.old_english: If we can't ship your order within the time we've stated, we'll email you. You can then wait for it or cancel for a full refund of the items not shipped.
shipping-info.new_english: If we can't ship your order within 5 business days, we'll email you before that time ends with a new date. You can then wait for it or cancel for a full refund of the items not shipped.

faqs.old_english: Orders are prepared in 1–3 business days, then shipped. If checkout shows a delivery estimate for your address, use it as a guide, not a guaranteed date. Because most parcels travel internationally, allow extra time around holidays. See Shipping info.
faqs.new_english: Orders ship within 5 business days (most in about 3). If checkout shows a delivery estimate for your address, use it as a guide, not a guaranteed date. Because most parcels travel internationally, allow extra time around holidays. See Shipping info.

faqs.old_english: Unfulfilled means your order is being prepared (1–3 business days). Fulfilled means it has been packed for the carrier and your tracking number has been emailed. The first carrier scan can take 24–48 hours to appear.
faqs.new_english: Unfulfilled means your order is being prepared (up to 5 business days). Fulfilled means it has been packed for the carrier and your tracking number has been emailed. The first carrier scan can take 24–48 hours to appear.

faqs.old_english: We're sorry! Email us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and photos of the item, the size tag and the packaging. faqs.new_english: We're sorry! Tell us as soon as possible, ideally within 7 days of delivery, with your order number and photos of the item, the size tag and the packaging. We'll send a replacement or refund, and usually you won't need to return anything. Reports after 7 days are still reviewed where the law gives you longer rights.

return-policy.old_english: If something arrives damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered, email us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and clear photos of the item, the label or size tag, and the packaging. Once we confirm the issue we will send a replacement or issue a refund for the affected item. In most of these cases you do not need to send anything back. Reports after 7 days are still reviewed where the law gives you longer rights.
return-policy.new_english: If something arrives damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered, please tell us as soon as possible, ideally within 7 days of delivery, with your order number and clear photos of the item, the label or size tag, and the packaging. Once we confirm the issue, you can choose a replacement or a refund for the affected item. In most of these cases you do not need to send anything back. Reports after 7 days are still reviewed where the law gives you longer rights.

return-policy.old_english: This policy does not limit any rights you have under the consumer laws of your country. For example, customers in the EU and UK have a right to cancel online purchases within 14 days of delivery. Where local law gives you more protection, the law applies.
return-policy.new_english: This policy does not limit any rights you have under the consumer laws of your country. For example, customers in the EU and UK have a right to cancel online purchases within 14 days of receiving them, without the tag and packaging conditions above (see our Refund Policy). Australian customers keep their guarantees under the Australian Consumer Law. Where local law gives you more protection, the law applies.

policy-shipping.old_english: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days after payment is confirmed. During holidays, promotions or high-volume periods, processing may take 1–2 more business days. Orders flagged for payment or address verification ship after verification is complete.
policy-shipping.new_english: We ship every order within 5 business days after payment is confirmed; most orders ship in about 3. "Shipped" means handed to the carrier with tracking. Orders held for payment or address verification ship within 5 business days after verification is complete.

policy-shipping.old_english: If we cannot ship your order within the time we stated, we will email you. You may then agree to the new date or cancel the unshipped items for a full refund.
policy-shipping.new_english: If we cannot ship your order within 5 business days, we will email you before that time ends with a revised shipping date (or tell you if we cannot give one). You may accept the delay or cancel the unshipped items for a full refund, issued within 7 working days (for card payments, within one billing cycle).

policy-shipping.old_english: If tracking shows the parcel as delivered but you cannot find it, check around your property, with neighbors and building reception, and wait 48 hours, because carriers sometimes scan early. Then report it to us within 14 days of the delivery scan and we will file a claim with the carrier and help you through it. Ownership and risk of loss pass to you when the carrier delivers the parcel to the address you provided. Any replacement or refund for a parcel confirmed as delivered depends on the outcome of the carrier investigation, except where the law requires otherwise.
policy-shipping.new_english: If tracking shows the parcel as delivered but you cannot find it, check around your property, with neighbors and building reception, and wait 48 hours, because carriers sometimes scan early. Then report it to us within 14 days of the delivery scan and we will file a claim with the carrier and help you through it. Ownership and risk of loss pass to you when the carrier delivers the parcel to the address you provided. For consumers in the EU and UK, risk passes only when you, or a person you name other than the carrier, take physical possession of the goods. Any replacement or refund for a parcel confirmed as delivered depends on the outcome of the carrier investigation, except where the law requires otherwise.

policy-shipping.old_english: If your parcel or items arrive damaged, take photos of the packaging and the items and email us within 7 days of delivery (reports after 7 days are still reviewed where the law gives you longer rights). See our Refund Policy.
policy-shipping.new_english: If your parcel or items arrive damaged, take photos of the packaging and the items and tell us as soon as possible, ideally within 7 days, so we can open a carrier claim. Later reports are still accepted in line with your legal rights. See our Refund Policy.

policy-terms.new_english: • We ship every order within 5 business days after payment is confirmed. If we cannot, we will email you before that time ends with a revised date, and you may accept the delay or cancel the unshipped items for a full refund, as described in our Shipping Policy.

policy-privacy.old_english: When you join our newsletter, we offer a one-time discount on your first order in exchange for your email address. We use it to send marketing emails. We estimate the value of your email address to our business as roughly equal to the value of the discount offered. Joining is optional, and you can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email.
policy-privacy.new_english: When you join our newsletter, we offer a one-time discount on your first order in exchange for your email address. We use it to send marketing emails. We estimate the value of a subscriber's email address at about $8.50, which is the cost to us of the 10% discount on our average order of about $85. We calculated this from the expense of providing the discount. Joining is optional, and you can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email.
